attestation_scope: Sanitized, post-hoc derivation from the retained native Kimi Code session record. This file supports model and route attribution; it is not part of the mathematical acceptance layer.

route_endpoint.definition: The successful tool result of python3 -u exp19b_exact_yt.py, the first exact replayable period-23 nonconvergence certificate in the realized route.
checks_recorded_in_endpoint_stdout: positive leading minors for F and G
exact KKT-branch fixed point in its cone
checks_made_explicit_by_post_hoc_hardeni: exact symmetry of F and G

timing_through_endpoint.method: Pair step.begin and step.end events by UUID, keep completed intervals ending at or before the endpoint, sum all intervals for cumulative agent time, and merge overlaps for active wall time.

human_input_through_endpoint.note: Counts were reconstructed from the native wire record. System-generated task notifications are not counted as human instructions.

starting_condition.post_hoc_tool_call_path_audit: No recorded tool-call argument accessed the Codex project or another sibling workspace. Session-internal task logs and the run workspace were accessed. This observation is not a claim of filesystem-level isolation.

artifact_lineage.terminal_kimi_result: Exact dyadic 23-step non-KKT replay with exact Jury stability verification and local attraction in the canonical reduced state; post-hoc hardening made minimality and additional guards explicit.
artifact_lineage.post_route_release_strengthening: The denominator-100 canonical QP, rational Lyapunov matrix, support-radius bound, and explicit invariant ellipsoid were constructed after the terminal run and are not charged to the Kimi route endpoint.

privacy_boundary.reason: The raw records contain conversations and user-specific paths. The public record contains only sanitized aggregates, event definitions, and hashes.

limitations: The run was audited post hoc rather than preregistered.
The intended experiment-specific KIMI_CODE_HOME and observer checkpoint exporter were not used.
The evidence supports Kimi K3 attribution and the recorded frozen starting workspace, but not an operating-system-enforced strict-blind claim.
The Codex and Kimi routes were not matched experiments and do not support causal model ranking.
